actions.name: RagnarLocker ransomware encrypts files
actions.description: RagnarLocker encrypts all available files of interest except those in excluded folders and with excluded extensions, allowing the computer to continue to operate normally while encrypting files with known and unknown extensions containing data of value to the victim.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: RagnarLocker excludes specific folders from encryption
actions.description: RagnarLocker does not encrypt files in folders such as Windows, Windows.old, Mozilla, Mozilla Firefox, Tor browser, Internet Explorer, $Recycle.Bin, Program Data, Google, Opera, and Opera Software.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: RagnarLocker excludes specific file extensions from encryption
actions.description: RagnarLocker does not encrypt files with extensions .db, .sys, .dll, .lnk, .msi, .drv, and .exe.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: RagnarLocker deletes Volume Shadow Copies
actions.description: RagnarLocker attempts to silently delete all Volume Shadow Copies to prevent user recovery of encrypted files using two methods: 'vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet' and 'wmic.exe.shadowcopy.delete'.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: RagnarLocker terminates services used by managed service providers
actions.description: RagnarLocker iterates through all running services and terminates services commonly used by managed service providers to remotely administer networks.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: RagnarLocker identifies attached hard drives and assigns drive letters
actions.description: RagnarLocker identifies all attached hard drives using Windows APIs and assigns a drive letter to any volumes not assigned a logical drive letter, making them accessible for encryption.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: RagnarLocker checks for victim location and terminates if in certain countries
actions.description: RagnarLocker uses Windows API GetLocaleInfoW to identify the location of the infected machine and terminates the process if the victim location is identified as Azerbaijani, Armenian, Belorussian, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Moldavian, Tajik, Russian, Turkmen, Uzbek, Ukrainian, or Georgian.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.

actions.name: RagnarLocker checks for current infections to prevent multiple encryption
actions.description: RagnarLocker checks for current infections to prevent multiple transform encryption of the data, potentially corrupting it, by gathering unique machine GUID, OS product name, user name, and generating a unique identifier via a custom hashing algorithm.
actions.reproducibility_reason: Requires Windows VM and native readiness/behavior checks; the local VM runtime and validated guest image are not configured.
